4n1d:
Program Description

These days, accounting is about so much more than crunching numbers. Accountancy is complex, and brings into play a number of expert skills.

Students will learn and develop a combination of accounting, finance and other business skills including accounting techniques and policies relating to corporate finance, tax, auditing, corporate governance, management accounting, corporate reporting and statistics.

Students will offer tuition that is supported by experienced teaching staff with strong industry connections. Guest speakers from the public and private sectors add value to the course. In addition, transferable skills of time management, project management, communication, collection and management of data and IT skills will serve them well in the future, whatever their career choice.
4n1e:
Program Description

Accounting is more than just number crunching.

On this accredited courses students will learn and develop a combination of accounting, finance and other business skills.

Students are accredited by major UK accounting institutes and this highly regarded course will prepare them for a range of careers in accounting or further study.

All the Joint Honours Accounting degrees involve the same compulsory accounting modules but concentrate students' option choices into a specialised route.

Students will study six modules, over two trimesters, per year. They'll learn by a variety of teaching methods including lectures, tutorials, workshops, directed learning and independent study.

On successful completion of Year 3, students will be eligible for an unclassified degree, and on successful completion of Year 4, an Honours degree.
4n1j:
Program Description

This Business Management course provides students with opportunities to discover how all organisations are managed, and develop and grow.

Students will explore the internal structures and strategies which businesses adopt in response to the key external drivers for change which impact upon them.

With flexible study options and practical content, the aim of the BA (Hons) Business Management is to offer a number of major/minor combinations which take advantage of the flexibility of the modular structure and promote student choice. This course provides modules that give students real-world experience and the option to undertake a work placement.

92% of graduates were in work or further study within 6 months of graduating in 2018.
4n1k:
Program Description

This Business Management with Entrepreneurship course combines a broad range of academic theory in the area of business management with the latest applied thinking in the field of entrepreneurship.

This course provides modules that give students real-world experience and the option to undertake a work placement.

This will prepare students for a range of projects and careers with small, medium and large employers, or for venturing out on their own.

In the first two years students will build a foundation in the essentials of effective business management. This foundation prepares students for the options to engage with applied learning within an industry placement, or to explore diverse cultures through studying abroad within the extensive partner network.

This course offers students excellent employability skills including professional presentation, team working, leadership, communication and problem solving.
4n1m:
Program Description

The Business Management with Marketing course combines broad ranging business knowledge with strategic marketing competencies.

This course provides modules that give students real-world experience and the option to undertake a work placement.

The course will further advance students' creative and innovative skills to successfully market and promote themselves across a variety of industries and sectors.

In the first two years students will build a foundation in the essentials of effective business management. This foundation prepares students for the options to engage with applied learning within an industry placement, or to explore diverse cultures through studying abroad within the extensive partner network.

This course offers students excellent employability skills including professional presentation, team working, leadership, communication and problem solving.
4n2w:
Program Description

Whilst studying, students will gain a strong foundation in a wide range of business and management disciplines, together with skills and experience that will enable them to meet the challenges of a career in the fast changing international business environment.

Students will become competent in the analysis of the impact of cultural differences on a wide variety of business decisions and consumer behaviour.

The study of the international business environment and its particular needs will be reinforced by a compulsory year abroad of study or a combination of study abroad and work-based learning abroad.
4n36:
With its rich history, abundance of attractions and world-famous festivals, the city is a centre for travellers and tourists from all over the world. Hospitality and tourism businesses flourish here, so students will have plenty of opportunities to gain work experience.

Students will develop their skills in the design, delivery and management of food, beverage and accommodation to top industry standards within a global business environment.

With options of a 24-week work placement, this course will equip students with the knowledge and practical preparation them need to successfully pursue a career in international hospitality management.
4n5p:
With its rich history, abundance of attractions and world-famous festivals, the city is a centre for travellers and tourists from all over the world. Hospitality and tourism businesses flourish here, so students have plenty of opportunities to gain work experience.

This course allows students to pursue a career in both the hospitality and festival and event industries. With international hospitality management at the core, it has been designed to meet the current needs of the industry.

Similar to the BA (Hons) International Hospitality Management, students will study the principles of hospitality management, specialising in festival and event. At ENU, they teach their students in an applied way, which means that they will be able to put their learnings into practice. Students will apply this knowledge to practical situations on an industry-based work placement or live project, preparing them for a career in the hospitality and festival and event industries.

Alternatively students can choose to study abroad through the international exchange links in Europe and the USA.

This course is studied full-time over four years. Students will learn by a variety of teaching methods including lectures, tutorials and independent study. There is a work placement option in Year 3.
79uf: The MSc Business Analytics program equips students with the knowledge, skills, and hands-on experience they need to become a business-ready analytics professional. This course is hands-on and focuses on the practical application of analytical techniques in business settings, rather than their mathematical underpinnings. The course is a good fit if students aspire to a new career in business intelligence, business insight, business analysis, management consultancy or simply wish to make better use of data and more accurate decisions in their current field. The curriculum aligns with the Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) qualification, potentially shortening a student's path to CAP certification.
4n60:
On this course, students will explore the issues facing contemporary businesses, developing their management skills and enhance their qualifications on this course.

Whether students are contemplating a career in business or currently working and looking to enhance their qualifications, this MSc Business Management will equip them with the practical skills to advance their career.

At Edinburgh Napier University, they prepare students for the real world, by helping them develop their skills, for example put forward their argument, build a case that is underpinned with evidence and rigor.

This means students will develop a deep level of understanding of a broad range of business management disciplines with an opportunity for broaden their skill base in a chosen specialism. This course has been designed to help them to develop their personal and professional skills.
6d72: Logistics and supply chain management throughout the world has never been the subject of so much public, organisational, and academic debate as in recent years. Logistics and supply chains have become a prominent and dynamic area in a wide range of industries and sectors. The global pandemic, port congestion, and Brexit has drawn out activities which normally happen in the background into the foreground. Alongside this, the debates surrounding globalisation, onshoring, supply chain configuration, sustainability, and industry/supply chain 4.0 make this field dynamic and future focused. The globalisation of activities makes it essential that the professional practices relating to (international) logistics and supply chain management processes are improved and regarded as a key element in the preparation of organisations’ strategies. The programme supports the achievement of the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in particular: Goal 12 - Responsible Consumption and Production, and Goal 13 - Climate Action, alongside a live business challenge.
63q0:
Program Description

Whether students are contemplating a career in international business or currently working and planning to enhance their qualifications, this course will give them the tools they need to be successful in the international business management arena.

Covering issues such as intercultural business communication, strategy, innovation, global economics and global marketing, it addresses the essentials of modern international business and opens doors to increased employment opportunities at postgraduate level.

Students will be encouraged to reflect on the approach to international business in their own culture and contribute relevant examples in class discussions.

Students will learn to creatively address the issues of global competition and sustainability while acquiring knowledge of international business and its economic environment. Students will graduate with an advanced understanding of the complexities of global economics and international business.
4n5y:
This MBA programme is designed to develop students' skills as a manager and leader on an international stage. At Edinburgh Napier University, they do this by supporting students' study in analyzing environments, formulating strategy, taking decisions and leading change programmes.

The course helps students develop practical experience and insight as well as build valuable links between theory and practice, and enhances their overall employability.

The programme covers the full range of MBA skills as well as additional action learning and critical reflection skills – essential for the modern manager.

Students will acquire creative problem solving, critical reasoning and strategic thinking skills, and apply these to their learning about global economic principles, strategic business issues, organizational management and the realities of the competitive marketplace.

Students will develop their written and verbal communication techniques, giving them the confidence to present their ideas and strategies to the business world.
4n5z:
The Edinburgh Napier MBA (Strategic Project Management) appeals to people with a wide range of backgrounds and experience; be they recent graduates or business professionals with perhaps many years’ experience, or specialist managers who are looking for a formal qualification to consolidate their experiential knowledge. It has equal relevance to those in the public, private and third sectors.

This programme will develop students’ personal and professional skills of independent thinking, critical analysis and reflective learning, proving students are able to operate in today’s rapidly changing global landscape and have the ability to solve problems at a strategic level.

In recent years, Edinburgh Napier MBA students have come from all sectors including professionals from health, social care, engineering, police, business consultants and those who have decided to take a career break or who wish to change career direction. In The MBA (Strategic Project Management) students will study organisations, focusing in particular on the role of leaders and managers in determining the organisation’s mission, vision and strategic direction.
